blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.

CurvDelta通过分析预适应模型周围的保存约束的局部几何特征,构建了一个低曲率空间,其中参数更新使得保存损失几乎无变化. 我们通过Kronecker构件的近似曲面(K-FAC)和因子化的预测,使其LLMs的建造切实可行。 我们还引入了CurvLORA,这是同一保护几何学范围内的一个低级变体,旨在更有效地适应. 这两种方法都适用于诸如能力学习和有选择的不学习等受保护的适应任务。 我们评价我们的方法 数学推理,代码生成, 和知识不学习。 就数学推理和代码生成而言,我们的方法在下游取得了具有竞争力的绩效,同时更好地保持了一般能力,提供了相对于基线的有利收购-保留取舍。 就知识不学习而言,我们在TOFU和MUSE方面的主要结果显示,目标明确的遗忘和知识保留之间比基线更平衡,保留业绩接近于切换再培训参考。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) need to evolve after pretraining. New tasks and domains call for additional capabilities, while privacy, safety, and data-governance requirements can necessitate selective unlearning. Retraining from scratch for every adaptation query is costly, motivating fine-tuning and parameter-efficient methods for capability learning and selective unlearning ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Cao & Yang, 2015 ; Maini et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Although learning and unlearning change behavior in different ways, both require the update to be selective: progress on the target objective should preserve unrelated knowledge and capabilities.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)需要在预训后进行演化. 新的任务和领域要求增加能力,而隐私、安全和数据治理要求则需要有选择地不学习。 从零开始对每个适应查询进行再培训的费用高昂,激发了能力学习和选择性不学习的微调和参数效率高的方法(Hu等,2022;Cao & Yang,2015;Maini等,2024;Shi等,2025)。 虽然学习和不学习改变行为的方式不同,但两者都需要有选择性地更新:目标目标的进展应当保留不相关的知识和能力.

blocks.en: To preserve existing capabilities while allowing the changes needed for adaptation, prior work has introduced different approaches to limiting unwanted changes. Replay and regularization incorporate preservation into the training objective ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ; Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) . Another line of work constrains the space in which adaptation may move, either by projecting task gradients ( Chaudhry et al., 2019 ; Ikram et al., 2026 ) or by heuristically restricting adaptation to orthogonal or null subspaces of parameters or representations ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Xiong & Xie, 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ; Liang & Li, 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Despite improvements, these methods either do not guarantee that the parameter update satisfies the intended constraint or impose strong constraints in parameter or representation space that are only indirectly tied to capability preservation. These limitations can lead to an unfavorable adaptation–preservation trade-off.
blocks.zh: 为了保持现有能力,同时允许适应所需的变化,先前的工作采用了不同的方法来限制不必要的变化。 重放和规范化将保存纳入培训目标(Rolnick等,2019;Kirkpatrick等,2017. 另一行工作通过预测任务梯度(Chaudhry等人,2019年;Ikram等人,2026年)或以雄心力限制适应参数或表示的正向或正向子空间(Fang等人,2025年;Xiong & Xie,2026年;Ju等人,2026年;Liang & Li,2024年;Luo等人,2026年),限制了适应可能移动的空间. 尽管有改进,这些方法要么无法保证参数更新满足预期的制约,要么对参数或表示空间施加严格的限制,而这种限制只是间接地与能力保存联系在一起的。 这些限制可能导致不利的适应-保护取舍。

blocks.en: To address this question, we introduce CurvDelta, a framework for low-curvature delta modeling for surgical learning and unlearning (Figure 1 ). CurvDelta learns a dense delta within a fixed low-curvature space. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant that uses the same preservation geometry for more efficient adaptation. The method is built around the following three core ideas.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了CurvDelta,一个用于外科学习和不学习的低曲线三角形模型的框架(图1)。 CurvDelta在固定的低曲率空间内学习出密集的三角地. 我们还引入了CurvLORA,一种低等变体,使用相同的保存几何来更高效地进行改造. 这种方法围绕以下三个核心思想来构建.

blocks.en: 1. Preservation through a task-independent delta parameterization. CurvDelta derives a low-curvature delta space from the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model. It constrains a trainable delta into this fixed space before applying it, keeping the realized update constrained throughout optimization. Because the space depends only on the base model and preservation set, the same preservation geometry can be reused across task sets, task objectives, and delta parameterizations.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 通过任务独立的三角参数化保存. CurvDelta从预适应模型周围的保存约束的局部几何学得到低曲率三角地平面空间. 它在应用这个固定空间之前会限制可被训练的三角洲,在整个优化过程中会限制实现的更新. 由于空间仅依赖于基模型和保存集,因此同样的保存几何可以被跨任务集,任务目标,和三角地参数化重用.

blocks.en: 2. Scalable delta space construction for dense and low-rank adaptation. To make low-curvature delta space construction tractable at LLM scale, CurvDelta approximates preservation curvature with a block-diagonal Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) ( Martens & Grosse, 2015 ) . It further applies factorwise spectral truncation to obtain a separable two-sided projection that can be stored and applied efficiently using compact eigenvector bases. The same construction supports both dense adaptation in CurvDelta and low-rank adaptation in CurvLoRA.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 可伸缩的三角洲空间建设,以进行密集而低等的适应. 为使低曲率三角洲空间构造在LLM尺度上可被取道,CurvDelta将保存曲面与区块-对角-克罗内克因子相近近曲面(K-FAC)(Martens & Grosse, 2015). 它进一步运用了因子光谱截取法来得到可分离的双侧投影,这种投影法可以使用紧凑的精益离子基进行存储和应用. 同样的构造支持CurvDelta的密集适应和CurvLORA的低等适应.

blocks.en: 3. An explicit preservation guarantee from curvature and displacement. We show that preservation is jointly controlled by the curvature of the retained delta space and the magnitude of the realized update. Specifically, we derive an upper bound on the local preservation loss in which curvature determines the cost per unit displacement, while the delta norm determines the total displacement. Under the local quadratic and block-diagonal K-FAC models, this bound provides a sufficient condition for both CurvDelta and CurvLoRA to satisfy the preservation constraint.
blocks.zh: 3个 明确保护不至于曲率和流离失所。 我们显示,保存是由保留三角洲空间的曲率和实际更新的规模共同控制的。 具体来说,我们从当地保存损失中得出一个上限,其中曲率决定了单位流离失所的成本,而三角洲规范则决定了全部流离失所。 在局部四相和区块-对角K-FAC模型下,这一约束为CurvDelta和CurvLORA都提供了满足保全约束的充分条件.

blocks.en: Experimental results. We evaluate our framework on capability learning and selective unlearning. For capability learning, we study mathematical reasoning and code generation together with retention of general knowledge. Our approach achieves competitive downstream performance while reducing degradation in general capabilities, yielding a favorable acquisition–retention trade-off relative to the evaluated baselines. For selective unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the evaluated baselines. On TOFU, our approach suppresses targeted knowledge while maintaining utility comparable to the retraining reference. On MUSE, it substantially reduces targeted memorization while retaining most of the retrained model’s performance.
blocks.zh: 实验结果. 我们评价我们关于能力学习和选择性不学习的框架。 对于能力学习,我们研究数学推理和代码生成,同时保留通才. 我们的办法实现了竞争的下游业绩,同时减少了一般能力的退化,从而产生了相对于评估基线的有利收购-保留取舍。 为了有选择地不学习,我们在TOFU和MUSE方面的主要结果显示,在目标明确的遗忘和知识保留之间,比评价的基线更平衡。 在TOFU方面,我们的方法压制了有针对性的知识,同时保持与再培训参考书类似的效用。 在MUSE方面,它大大减少了定向记忆,同时保留了大部分重新训练的模型的性能.

blocks.en: Our factorwise construction yields a subspace of the full K-FAC eigenspace with eigenvalues at most κ \kappa . Unlike product-spectrum thresholding ( Ikram et al., 2026 ) , which applies a non-separable elementwise mask across the full Kronecker eigenbasis, factorwise truncation produces the separable two-sided projection in Eq. ( 7 ). This substantially reduces storage and computational costs by caching only the leading factor eigenvectors, and allows applying the projection directly to low-rank factors without materializing a dense matrix, yielding CurvLoRA. While it may discard mixed directions where a small eigenvalue in one factor offsets a large eigenvalue in the other, empirical evidence of abundant flat directions ( Sagun et al., 2017 ; Ghorbani et al., 2019 ) and low-dimensional optimization ( Li et al., 2018 ; Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ) suggests that the retained space still provides sufficient capacity for adaptation (Appendix B.5 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Delta Parameterizations and Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 三角洲参数化和优化

blocks.en: Having constructed the fixed low-curvature update space in Section 3.2 , we now turn to representing and optimizing task-specific updates within it. The projected form supports two complementary parameterizations: a dense delta that spans the entire retained space and a low-rank LoRA delta that reduces the number of trainable parameters, yielding CurvDelta and CurvLoRA, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在第3.2节建造了固定的低曲线更新空间后,我们现在转向代表并优化其中针对具体任务的更新。 所预测的形式支持两个互补参数化:一个覆盖整个保留空间的密集三角洲和一个能减少可被训练参数数量的低等LORA三角洲,分别产生CurvDelta和CurvLORA.

blocks.en:
We study capability acquisition in mathematical reasoning and code generation. For mathematical reasoning, we fine-tune on 100K examples sampled from MetaMathQA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and evaluate on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021b ) . For code generation, we fine-tune on 104K examples sampled from CodeFeedback ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) and evaluate on HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) .
To measure knowledge retention, we evaluate on TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) , NQ-Open ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) , and MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021a ) .
For the preservation set 𝒟 pres \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{pres}} , we use 256 examples sampled from the FineFineWeb corpus ( M-A-P et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们在数学推理和代码生成方面研究能力获取. 对于数学推理,我们微调了从MetaMathQA(Yu等,2024年)抽样的100K例,并对GSM8K(Cobbe等,2021年)和MATH(Hendrycks等,2021年b)进行了评价. 对于代码生成,我们微调了从CodeFeedback(郑等,2024年)中抽取的104K例,并对HumanEval(陈等,2021年)和MBPP(奥斯汀等,2021年)进行了评价.
为了衡量知识保留,我们评价了TriviaQA(Joshi等,2017年),NQ-Open(Kwiatkowski等,2019年)和MMLU(Hendrycks等,2021a.).
对于保存集 D pres \ mathcal{ D}_{\- mathrm{ pres}}- , 我们使用从 FineFineWebbacle (M- A- P等, 2024) 样本中的256个实例 。

blocks.en: We evaluate both tasks using the pretrained base checkpoints of Gemma-3-1B ( Gemma Team et al., 2025 ) and Llama-2-7B ( Touvron et al., 2023 ) . For PEFT methods and CurvLoRA, we set the rank to 128 for Gemma-3-1B and 32 for Llama-2-7B, holding it fixed across tasks.

blocks.en: We include standard fine-tuning (FT) as an unconstrained adaptation reference and experience replay (Replay) ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ) as a data-based baseline. Replay mixes task examples with examples sampled from 𝒟 pres \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{pres}} during fine-tuning. We additionally include CrispEdit ( Ikram et al., 2026 ) as a curvature-based gradient-projection baseline and OPLoRA ( Xiong & Xie, 2026 ) as an orthogonal delta-projection baseline. We further compare against LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , PiSSA ( Meng et al., 2024 ) , MiLoRA ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and the knowledge-preserved version of CorDA ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 compare the acquisition–retention trade-off in mathematical reasoning and code generation. Full fine-tuning provides strong capability acquisition but consistently reduces general-knowledge retention, whereas CurvDelta keeps downstream performance competitive while preserving substantially more general knowledge across both domains. This pattern is strongest for code generation: CurvDelta attains the strongest joint averages on both backbones, with downstream performance close to or above full fine-tuning and the highest average retention among the reported adaptation methods. On mathematical reasoning, CurvDelta remains close to full fine-tuning in downstream performance while substantially narrowing the retention gap. The low-rank trade-off varies by backbone: CurvLoRA achieves the highest average retention among adaptation methods on Llama, though with lower downstream performance than CurvDelta, while CurvDelta provides the stronger joint result on Gemma. Overall, restricting updates to the low-curvature space shifts the acquisition–retention trade-off toward better general-knowledge retention; the dense variant delivers stronger joint results in most task–backbone pairs, while CurvLoRA remains competitive with fewer trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2比较了在数学推理和代码生成方面的购置-保留取舍。 全面微调可提供强大的能力获取,但持续地减少一般知识的保留,而CurvDelta则保持下游的性能竞争力,同时在两个领域保留更通俗的知识。 这种模式对于代码生成最强:CurvDelta在两种主干线上都实现了最强的联想平均值,下游的性能接近或高于完全微调,在所报告的适应方法中平均留存率也最高. 在数学推理方面,CurvDelta在下游性能上仍然接近于完全微调,同时大大缩小了保留差距. 低等取舍因主干不同而异: CurvLORA在Llama上的适应方法中实现了最高的平均保留量,虽然下游性能低于CurvDelta,而CurvDelta为Gemma提供了更强的联合结果. 总体而言,限制低曲线空间的更新将获取-保留权衡转向更好的一般知识保留;密集的变体在大多数任务-后骨配对中提供了更强的联合结果,而CurvLORA仍然具有较少可训练参数的竞争力。

blocks.zh: 4.2 选择性不学习

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on two widely-used LLM unlearning benchmarks: TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) and MUSE ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . TOFU provides a controlled unlearning setting based on synthetic author-profile QA pairs, whereas MUSE evaluates verbatim and knowledge memorization on real-world text corpora.
For TOFU, we evaluate the Forget 5% and Forget 10% settings on three instruction-tuned backbones spanning 3B–8B scales: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . We omit the Forget 1% setting because it is too weak to distinguish methods. For MUSE, we use the benchmark’s Llama-2-7B target model on the Books corpus. Further details are provided in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们对两个广泛使用的LLM不学习基准进行实验:TOFU(Maini等,2024年)和MUSE(Shi等,2025年)。 TOFU提供基于合成作者素描QA对的可控非学习设置,而MUSE则在现实世界文本corpora上评价逐字记录和知识记忆.
对TOFU来说,我们通过3B-8B尺度的3个指令调制主干线来评价遗忘5%和忘记10%的设置: Llama-3.2-3B-指令(Grattafiori等,2024年),Qune3-4B-指令-2507(杨等,2025年)和Llama-3.1-8B-指令(Grattafiori等,2024年). 我们省略了忘记1%的设置,因为它太弱,无法区分方法。 对于MUSE,我们使用基准的Llama-2-7B目标模型在"书本"上. 详见附录E.2。

blocks.en: We compare CurvLoRA and CurvDelta against five baselines: full fine-tuning (FT), CrispEdit ( Ikram et al., 2026 ) , LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , VILA ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and OPLoRA ( Xiong & Xie, 2026 ) . FT, LoRA, VILA, and OPLoRA represent full-parameter, standard parameter-efficient, unlearning-specific parameterizations, and orthogonal delta-projection adaptation, respectively, while CrispEdit is a curvature-based gradient-projection method. Each method is evaluated with three unlearning objectives: Gradient Difference (GradDiff) ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Maini et al., 2024 ) , Negative Preference Optimization (NPO) ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and SimNPO ( Fan et al., 2025 ) . Appendices D and E.2 provide the objective definitions and optimization settings, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了CurvLORA和CurvDelta与五个基线:全微调(FT)、CrispEdit(Ikram等,2026年),LORA(Hu等,2022年),VILA(Kim等,2025年)和OPLORA(Xiong等,2026年). FT、LORA、VILA和OPLORA分别代表全参数、标准参数效率高、不学习特定的参数,以及正交三角投影调整,而CrispEdit是一种以曲线为基础的梯度-投影方法。 评估每种方法时有三个不学习的目标: 渐差 (GradDiff) (刘等等,2022;Maini等,2024),负偏好优化 (NPO) (张等,2024), SimNPO (Fan等,2025). 附录 D和E.2分别提供了客观定义和优化设置.

blocks.en: For TOFU, we report three core metrics: Forget Quality (FQ), QA probability (FP), and model utility (MU). FQ is based on a KS-test p p -value that checks whether the unlearned model and a model retrained from scratch without the forget data behave similarly on the forget examples. We report the base-10 logarithm of this p p -value in the TOFU tables and denote the retrained model Retrain. For MUSE, we report forget verbatim memorization (VerbMem), forget knowledge memorization (KnowMem), and retain knowledge memorization (Retain KnowMem), all measured by ROUGE.

blocks.en: In general, CurvDelta improves the forgetting–retention balance on both TOFU and MUSE. On TOFU, CurvDelta attains the strongest Forget Quality in both forget splits and combines low forget-answer probability with model utility close to Retrain. CurvLoRA further lowers forget-answer probability in the 10% split, although its Forget Quality is lower than that of the dense variant. On MUSE, CurvDelta achieves the lowest verbatim memorization, whereas CurvLoRA retains more knowledge.

Specifically, we examine the projection basis, the spectral-energy threshold γ \gamma , and the preservation-data ratio (Figure 2 ), as well as delta parameterization versus gradient projection (Figure 4.3 ).

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of direction selection, we compare our low-curvature delta space with two dimension-matched variants constructed from high-curvature and random directions. As shown in Figure 2 (a), across learning rates, updates in the low-curvature space strengthen forgetting while maintaining model utility, whereas both variants lose utility at the largest learning rate while still producing weaker forgetting. These comparisons show that constructing the delta space from preservation curvature improves the forgetting–utility trade-off beyond its dimension.

blocks.en: Continuing with the same TOFU setting, Figure 4 (a) compares the empirical retain-set KL of CurvLoRA with the K-FAC quadratic approximation and the spectral bound in Eq. ( 8 ) across learning rates and thresholds γ \gamma (detailed values in Appendix Table 13 ). The K-FAC quadratic approximation remains below the spectral bound in every configuration. Although the local quadratic model around 𝜽 0 \bm{\theta}_{0} operates on a smaller numerical scale than the full-training retain-set KL, all three quantities share the same monotonic trends: larger γ \gamma removes more leading curvature directions and lowers all three values at each learning rate, whereas larger learning rates increase them. Across adaptation methods in Figure 4 (b), CurvDelta yields substantially lower retain-set KL than full fine-tuning and CrispEdit, and CurvLoRA attains the lowest retain-set KL among the low-rank methods.

blocks.en: 5.2 Computational Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2 计算效率

blocks.en: Figure 4 (c) compares end-to-end wall-clock runtime (including curvature estimation) and peak GPU memory across methods (detailed values in Appendix Table 14 ). Caching only the thin leading factor eigenbases rather than the full factor eigenbases and product mask required by CrispEdit enables CurvDelta to substantially cut total runtime with lower peak memory. Projecting low-rank factors directly in CurvLoRA further reduces peak memory relative to the dense variant while matching the runtime of OPLoRA. Moreover, because the cached eigenbases depend only on the base model, preservation set, and γ \gamma , they are computed once and reused across task objectives, hyperparameters, and delta parameterizations.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We studied how to incorporate a preservation-loss constraint into the model delta parameterization while retaining adaptation flexibility. Our answer is CurvDelta, which estimates local preservation curvature at the pre-adaptation model with block-diagonal K-FAC, retains trailing factor eigendirections via factorwise spectral truncation, and applies a two-sided projection so the realized delta remains in this fixed low-curvature space throughout optimization. The same geometry is reusable across tasks and objectives, supports both dense (CurvDelta) and low-rank (CurvLoRA) adaptation, and yields a local preservation bound governed jointly by retained curvature and delta magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, TOFU, and MUSE, our methods improve the acquisition–retention and forgetting–retention trade-offs over baselines, with retention close to the retraining reference.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了如何在保留适应灵活性的同时,将保全-损失限制纳入三角洲模型参数化。 我们的答案是 CurvDelta,它用区块-对角K-FAC在预适应模型中估算出局部的保存曲率,通过因子光谱截取保留了后继因子eigendictions,并采用双侧投影法,从而实现的三角洲在整个优化过程中都留在了这个固定的低曲率空间. 同样的几何可以跨任务和目标重复使用,支持密集(CurvDelta)和低等(CurvLORA)的适应,并产生一个由所保留的曲率和三角地尺度共同管理的局部保护约束. 通过数学推理、代码生成、TOFU和MUSE,我们的方法改进了获得-保留和忘记-保留在基线上的取舍,保留接近再培训参考。

blocks.en:
Preservation-aware task adaptation addresses the challenge of acquiring capabilities required by new tasks while limiting degradation of unrelated capabilities previously acquired.
Existing approaches differ in both the signal used to identify what should be preserved and the stage of adaptation they constrain.
Replay-based methods train on stored examples from earlier tasks, while self-synthesized rehearsal generates proxy examples when the original data are unavailable ( Rolnick et al., 2019 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) .
Optimization-based methods instead regularize parameters or reconcile competing objectives: EWC penalizes changes to parameters estimated to be important for earlier tasks ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) , whereas PCGrad, CAGrad, and GradDrop can mediate conflicts between task and preservation gradients when both losses are optimized jointly ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2020 ) .
PEFT methods constrain the update geometry in different ways. O-LoRA separates successive tasks through orthogonal low-rank subspaces ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; MiLoRA adapts minor singular components of pretrained weights; and CorDA provides a knowledge-preserved decomposition intended to limit degradation of pretrained knowledge ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2024 ) .
A further line of work explicitly constrains LoRA updates using subspaces derived from pretrained weights, task representations, or both ( Xiong & Xie, 2026 ; Liang & Li, 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . These constructions use orthogonality to protect selected parameter or representation subspaces during adaptation.
Model editing addresses a related preservation problem. ROME and MEMIT directly update selected MLP weights, while MEND learns an auxiliary editor that maps fine-tuning gradients to parameter updates ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Mitchell et al., 2022 ) .
AlphaEdit limits collateral changes by projecting editing perturbations into the null space of preserved-knowledge representations ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . CrispEdit projects task gradients into a low-curvature space estimated with K-FAC ( Ikram et al., 2026 ) .
CurvDelta derives its delta space from the local curvature of the preservation loss, relating the allowed update directions to their local preservation cost. It incorporates the projection into the delta parameterization, so that the realized delta remains in the prescribed space throughout optimization, independently of the optimizer. This combines a preservation-loss-based choice of geometry with an explicit constraint on the applied delta, supporting both dense and low-rank adaptation.
blocks.zh:
保护意识任务的适应既能应对获得新任务所需能力的挑战,又能限制先前获得的无关能力的退化。
现有办法在用于确定应保留什么的信号和它们所制约的适应阶段方面各不相同。
基于重放的方法在从先前的任务所存储的例子上进行训练,而自合成的排练则在原始数据无法获得时生成代理实例(Rolnick等,2019;Huang等,2024).
基于优化的方法将参数正规化或调和相互竞争的目标: EWC惩罚对前期任务重要估计参数的改变(Kirkpatrick等,2017年),而PCGrad, CAGrad,和GradDrop可以调解任务与保护梯度之间的冲突,如果两者同时优化损失(Yu等,2020年;Liu等,2021年;Chen等,2020年).
PEFT方法以不同的方式制约了更新几何. O-LORA通过正统低等子空间(Wang等,2023年)将相继的任务分开;MiLORA对预受训练重量的微单元成分进行适应;CORDA提供知识保留的分解,旨在限制预受训练知识的降解(Wang等,2025a; 杨等, 2024. ).
另一行工作明确限制LORA更新,使用从预受训练的重量,任务表示,或两者均衍生出来的子空间(Xiong & Xie,2026;Liang & Li,2024;Luo等,2026). 这些构件在适应过程中使用矫形来保护所选参数或代表子空间.
模型编辑解决了相关的保存问题. ROME和MEMIT直接更新所选的MLP权重,而MEND则学习一个辅助编辑器来将梯度与参数更新相映射(Meng等,2022;Meng等,2023;Mitchell等,2022.).
AlphaEdit通过将编辑扰动投射到保存的知识表达的空地来限制附带变化(Fang等,2025年). 冰冻 将项目任务梯度编辑为与 K-FAC 估计的低曲线空间(Ikram等, 2026年)。
CurvDelta的三角洲空间来自当地保存损失的曲率,将允许的更新方向与当地保存成本联系起来。 它将投影纳入到三角地参数化中,使已实现的三角地在整个优化过程中,独立于优化器而保持到规定的空间. 这结合了基于保全-损失的几何选择和对所应用三角洲的明确限制,支持密集和低等的适应.

blocks.en: LLM unlearning seeks to suppress knowledge or behavior associated with a designated forget set while preserving utility on unrelated data, providing a practical alternative to full retraining ( Cao & Yang, 2015 ) . Existing methods control this trade-off by modifying different objects in the update process. GradDiff couples ascent on the forget-set loss with training on retained data, whereas NPO and SimNPO regulate forgetting through bounded, preference-inspired losses ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) . GRU and SAGO instead reshape the instantaneous update direction using first-order forget–retain signals: GRU projects the unlearning gradient away from directions estimated to harm retention, while SAGO treats unlearning as an asymmetric two-task problem and gates the two gradients coordinate-wise according to their sign agreement ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Xiao et al., 2026a ) . LoRA-specific methods control the content or dynamics of the low-rank update. FILA and VILA use parameter-level forget-to-retain importance to initialize adapters, whereas ReGLU uses representation geometry both to initialize a discriminative low-rank subspace and to regularize the adapter update away from retained representations ( Cha et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026b ) . Null-space-constrained low-rank adaptation also uses benign hidden representations to restrict updates while combining safe-target response learning with suppression of undesired responses ( Ju et al., 2026 ) . Stable Forgetting instead applies bounded transformations to LoRA adapters to control their update dynamics ( Garg et al., 2025 ) . SOUL is the second-order counterpart, using second-order information to shape each unlearning step ( Jia et al., 2024 ) . CurvDelta derives its delta space from preservation-loss curvature, providing a local loss bound in terms of the retained curvature and delta magnitude. Both CurvDelta and CurvLoRA can optimize GradDiff, NPO, or SimNPO within this space.
blocks.zh: LLM unlearning 寻求压制与指定忘却集相关的知识或行为,同时保留对无关数据的实用性,为全面再培训提供了实用的替代(Cao & Yang, 2015). 现有方法通过修改更新过程中的不同对象来控制这种取舍. 通过对保留数据的培训,渐渐的Diff夫妇在遗忘损失上上升,而NPO和SimNPO则通过有限度的、受偏好启发的损失来规范遗忘(Liu等人,2022;Zhang等人,2024;Fan等人,2025)。 GRU和SAGO则使用一等忘却-保留信号重塑即时更新方向: GRU预测不学习梯度偏离估计会损害保留方向,而SAGO则将不学习视为不对称的双任务问题,并根据双方的签字协议,将两梯度坐标相接相接(Wang等,2025b;Shao等,2026a)。 LoRA的特定方法控制了低排名更新的内容或动态.
